svg.title: Grafana Tempo microservices architecture
svg.desc: Microservices architecture for Grafana Tempo: independently deployable services — distributor, Kafka ingest layer, ingester/live-store, block-builder, querier, query-frontend, compactor, and metrics-generator — each launched with its own -target flag.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do trace sources send data to Tempo?')
sendPrompt('What does the Tempo distributor do?')
g.text: -target=distributor · receives trace data · routes to ingesters

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does Kafka buffer trace streams in Tempo?')
sendPrompt('What does the Tempo ingester and live-store do?')
sendPrompt('What does the Tempo block-builder do?')
sendPrompt('What object storage does Tempo use for trace blocks?')
sendPrompt('What does the Tempo compactor do?')
sendPrompt('What does the Tempo metrics-generator do?')
sendPrompt('What does the Tempo querier do?')
sendPrompt('What does the Tempo query-frontend do?')
sendPrompt('How do Grafana and other clients query Tempo?')

svg.text: Each service independently deployable via its own -target flag — microservices mode
